About GetFitAI

Making personalized fitness accessible to everyone through AI.

GetFitAI was built with a simple mission: remove the barriers between people and effective workout plans. No expensive trainers, no confusing apps, no friction — just answer a few questions and get a personalized plan in seconds.

Our AI analyzes your goals, experience level, available equipment, and any injuries or limitations to create a workout plan that's tailored specifically to you. Every plan includes warm-up, main exercises with sets/reps/rest, and cool-down.

Instant Plans

Get a complete workout plan in under 30 seconds. No waiting, no forms.

Truly Personalized

AI adapts to your goals, experience, equipment, and even injuries.

Free to Start

Generate a plan instantly — no account needed. Sign in to save your plans.

For Everyone
